name: keltner_channel_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index price touches the outer Keltner Channel (EMA(24) ± 2.0 × ATR(24) = ±2 ATR from the 2-minute EMA), intraday momentum algorithms that drove the move have exhausted near-term order flow and the ATR-based band marks a micro-volatility-normalized extreme. Unlike Bollinger Bands that inflate on single outlier bars, ATR bands reflect the true recent micro-volatility — so a Keltner touch is a cleaner signal that the LAST bar was genuinely outsized relative to the prior 2 minutes of movement. At this point, delta-hedging dealers (long gamma from options they sold) and short-term mean-reversion desks that use EMA-anchored bands start fading aggressively with limit orders. The 5-second close BACK inside the band — with a bullish/bearish body showing that the current bar itself absorbed the excess — is the entry signal, targeting reversion to the 2-minute EMA within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Price wicks outside 2-ATR Keltner band then closes back inside with confirming body in flat EMA regime
